key_insight: RadKev is an open-weight radiology decision model that outperformed its general-purpose base models and matched or beat larger hosted systems for categorical radiology tasks.
clinical_relevance: Because it can run locally in a hospital, RadKev may support faster, privacy-preserving radiology decision support after local validation.
method: Fine-tuned Kev-27B and Kev-9B on 36,109 public radiology records.
Tested the resulting RadKev models on 14,142 held-out questions across 15 radiology tasks.
Compared accuracy and latency against hosted decision models and a large language model.
evidence_signal: On held-out evaluation, RadKev-27B improved over Kev-27B by 4.9 percentage points and was more accurate than Jev, OpenAI Decisions, and Qwen3.8-27B, while answering much faster than reasoning-based LLM use.
watch_item: Performance was shown on public datasets, so real-world deployment still needs validation on local hospital data and workflows.
paper_title: RadKev: An Open-Weight Decision Model for Radiology
